name: Crisp-E-O donut droid
description: The Crisp-E-O donut droid was a type of cooking droid that prepared donuts using an internal oil fryer. A unit belonging to the chef Dexter Jettster had access to a database of over 2,400 donut recipes, and it prepared Adarian-style donuts daily after selecting the recipes it considered the most delicious. Jettster employed his Crisp-E-O on the planet Coruscant first at the food stand Dex's Donuts, and later at the café Dex's Diner.
